'''2000 Modesto Enduro''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Modesto, CA on 15 July 2000. [[Kevin Shannon]] won it. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1020">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-18-enduro-7-15-modesto-cad1020/ enduro-7-15-modesto-ca], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 18 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-18-enduro-7-15-modesto-cad1020/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Modesto, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 34
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]
